arg_kinds.integer: k ∈ ℤ — adapter parses as Integer[k]
arg_kinds.decimal: general real non-integer non-half-integer — adapter parses as Rational from 60-dp string (R5 §6 L1 Wolfram input-trap)

tier_descriptions.T1: real positive z+a — all 16 heads; covers series/CF crossovers (R3 §3.3)
tier_descriptions.T2: real negative z — Gamma-family poles, LogGamma analytic continuation, Digamma reflection (R2 §1.3, R5 §6 L15)
tier_descriptions.T3: near-poles z near 0, -1, -2, ..., -5 with δ ∈ {±1e-2, ±1e-4, ±1e-6} — cancellation stress (ADR-0042 §Decision 3; R5 §6 L17)
tier_descriptions.T4: complex Q1-Q4 |z| ∈ [0.5, 12] — full Faddeeva-class complex paths (R5 §6 L14 for SciPy polygamma)
tier_descriptions.T5: half-integer a — R1 priority-A/B closed forms (DLMF §5.4-§5.5)
tier_descriptions.T6: large |z| ∈ (100, 1000] — Poincaré asymptotic / Stirling deep regime (R2 §1.7)
tier_descriptions.T7: near a ≈ z (Temme uniform asymptotic transition) — v0.1 carve-out per ADR-0042 §'What we will not decide'
tier_descriptions.T8: digamma near negative integers — reflection-formula near-pole cancellation; lossBits ≈ log₂(1/|δ|)

landmines_pinned.L1: Wolfram input-trap: all numerics as Rational strings / 60-dp decimals
landmines_pinned.L12: Incomplete-gamma regularisation: Upper, Lower, P, Q are FOUR DISTINCT HEADS — never share an input record
landmines_pinned.L14: SciPy 1.11.4 polygamma complex TypeError — T4 polygamma cells are gold-only (Wolfram + mpmath)
landmines_pinned.L15: SciPy loggamma(real_negative) → NaN; adapter passes x+0j
landmines_pinned.L17: Γ at non-positive integers: four oracle behaviors (ComplexInfinity, ValueError, +∞, NaN); comparator special-cases poles
landmines_pinned.v0.1-carve-out: T7 Temme region: G8 comparator tolerates precision - log₂(|a|) bits instead of precision - 4
